visualRisks.description: The house is isolated without any road connections, which might make it difficult for players to access or interact with the house.
There are multiple dead ends and disconnected paths that could confuse players trying to follow the route.

navigationRisks.description: The route includes a lot of backtracking and non-linear movement which might be confusing for players.
The route starts from a non-landmark area which might not be intuitive for players to start their journey.
